name: Retrieve IM Chat messages
description: Retrieve IM Chat messages Retrieve IM Chat messages for a specified period This API only supports oauth2. GET /v2/im/chat/sessions/{sessionId}
context:
GET /v2/im/chat/sessions/{sessionId}
Retrieve IM Chat messages for a specified period This API only supports oauth2.
Required: sessionId (path) — IM Chat Session ID; from (query) — Start Date; to (query) — End Date
Optional: page_size (query) — The number of records returned within a single API call; next_page_token (query) — Next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceed the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.
